products.name: Overnight Breakfast Muesli
products.subtitle: Improved & new formula · 1kg
products.description: A wholesome, nutrient-rich muesli of oats, nuts, seeds and dried fruit, designed to start your day with steady energy. Soak overnight and enjoy with yogurt, milk or your favourite toppings.
products.ingredients: Avena sativa, Lycium barbarum, Prunus dulcis, Linum usitatissimum, Morus alba, Vitis vinifera, Citrus sinensis, Pistacia vera, Crocus sativus, Cucurbita pepo, Helianthus annuus, Borassus flabellifer
products.directions: Take 2-3 spoons of muesli, or adjust the amount to suit your appetite, and place it in a bowl. Pour boiling water over the muesli until it is submerged halfway. Let it soak for 6-8 hours to soften and enhance its texture. Once ready, mix with yogurt, milk, or a lactose-free alternative and add fresh fruit, honey or your favourite toppings.
products.warnings: Contains nuts. Some individuals may experience mild gastrointestinal discomfort or allergic reactions. If symptoms persist, discontinue use and seek medical advice.
products.storage: Store in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight. Keep the product tightly sealed and use within 6 months of opening.
products.imageAlt: Amanah Health Products Dr Ali's Overnight Breakfast Muesli, 1kg pouch

products.name: Joint Support Oil
products.subtitle: Blend of natural oils · 200ml
products.description: A blend of natural oils for the inflammation of muscles, tendons and ligaments. Rub over the area of concern until absorbed; hot fomentation for 15-20 minutes gives better results.
products.ingredients: Sesamum indicum (sesame seed oil), Brassica alba (mustard seed oil), Nigella sativa (black seed oil), Syzygium aromaticum (clove oil), Mahanarayan oil, Rhumasyl oil
products.directions: Rub the oil over the area of concern till it is absorbed. If possible use hot fomentation for 15-20 minutes for better results.
products.warnings: Ensure you are not allergic to any of the ingredients. If you have any adverse reaction, stop using the oil and consult a healthcare provider. If pregnant or breastfeeding, use with caution and consult a healthcare provider.
products.storage: Store in a cool and dry place. Keep out of reach of children.
